ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and drone image monitoring platform designed to detect unauthorized construction, land encroachment, and environmental degradation in rural and institutional districts.
ideas.title: AkalSecure Land & Infrastructure AI Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by delivering concrete, visual, high-impact geographic data analysis that appeals directly to academic and municipal evaluators looking for real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: An interactive clinical training simulator utilizing computer vision pose-tracking for CPR and structured rubric scoring to train rural healthcare workers and medical students.
ideas.title: MediTrain AI: Rural Clinical Simulation Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the Cornell AI Hackathon grand prize winner by combining MediaPipe-based pose estimation with LLM-driven evaluation, providing a live, working demo that solves a critical healthcare training bottleneck.

ideas.pitch: A community-focused civic platform featuring an AI marketing copilot for local shop owners paired with an automated computer-vision garbage classification dashboard for municipal tracking.
ideas.title: CivicPulse Local Business & Waste Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning blueprint of catwalk and ROBOTICS-ai-garbage-classifier by targeting local community engagement and sustainability metrics that instantly resonate with regional judging panels.

ideas.pitch: An automated data engineering pipeline for university and organizational telemetry that detects schema or sensor anomalies, verifies repairs through an evidence gate, and creates pull requests automatically.
ideas.title: CampusDataHub Autonomous Incident Resolver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the prize-winning architecture of blackbox-datahub, showcasing hard engineering depth in autonomous system recovery and data lineage that stands out among standard CRUD project submissions.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent toolkit designed to coordinate team tasks, synthesize GitHub activity, track hackathon milestones, and generate real-time executive summaries for project managers.
ideas.title: Executive AI Chief of Staff for Student Teams
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the 1st place Civic Challenge winner (claw-chief-of-staff), focusing on practical developer workflow automation that judges will appreciate as a genuinely useful productivity tool.
